product: commentary — no product. Promotes a "female beauty scare ad" swipe file (reply-bait).
hook: "female beauty scare ads convert stupidly fast."
body: Scare ads convert because they don't educate — they show the future the customer is afraid of ("this is what happens if you ignore it"), not the benefit ("get glowing skin"). Fear beats features when the pain is already there. A swipe file of the format plus examples is offered via reply bait; 36s video attached.

sequencing: Mechanism: show the feared future, don't educate.
Rule: fear beats features when pain exists.
why_it_works: Loss aversion — the feared future is more motivating than the promised one.
what_to_steal: LC scare angle: "this is what your skin looks like after a summer of cheap jewelry" — feared-future framing for tarnish.

product: Anque — 10-functional-mushroom raspberry gummies (2/day; 200,000+ women users; 60-day money-back guarantee; buy-2-get-1-free offer).
hook: "what happens if you only poop twice a week?"
body: The ad turns the product into a 4-week storyline: week 1, things start moving (reishi calms cortisol); week 2, regularity; week 3, bloat drops (chaga rebuilds gut lining); week 4, energy and clarity return (lion's mane plus cordyceps). Each week gives a new reason to keep watching; the product enters as the mechanism behind the transformation, not the story itself. Closes with proof (200,000 women), guarantee, and the B2G1 offer.
idea: A 30-second ad structured as a 4-week transformation timeline: hook → curiosity → timeline → mechanism → transformation → proof → offer.
formatting: 74s vertical video (720x1280); week-by-week text overlays implied.
why_it_works: The timeline creates four open loops — each week is a new reason to keep watching; the transformation, not the product, is the story.
what_to_steal: The exact 4-week skeleton for LC: "what happens if you wear the same necklace for 4 weeks straight — week 1… week 4, still perfect" with the waterproof mechanism as the reveal.
